home.hero.subtitle: A Journey Through 2000+ Years of Rich Cultural Legacy
home.hero.description: Explore the timeless traditions, magnificent temples, classical arts, and vibrant heritage of Tamil civilization

home.timeline.title: How We Bring Heritage to Life
home.timeline.subtitle: From field discovery to global celebration
home.timeline.cards.discovery.title: Discover & Document
home.timeline.cards.discovery.descriptio: Field historians and volunteers chronicle oral histories, temple lore, and community traditions on-site.
home.timeline.cards.preservation.title: Digitize & Preserve
home.timeline.cards.preservation.descrip: Our archivists restore manuscripts and artifacts using high-resolution imaging and 3D mapping.
home.timeline.cards.outreach.title: Share & Celebrate
home.timeline.cards.outreach.description: Festivals, workshops, and digital showcases connect diasporas with authentic Tamil heritage.
home.mission.title: What Tamil Heritage Foundation Does
home.mission.preserve.title: Preserve & Document
home.mission.preserve.desc: Safeguarding ancient manuscripts, artifacts, and cultural practices for future generations through digital archiving and restoration.
home.mission.educate.title: Educate & Research
home.mission.educate.desc: Conducting scholarly research and educational programs to deepen understanding of Tamil history, literature, and traditions.
home.mission.celebrate.title: Celebrate & Promote
home.mission.celebrate.desc: Organizing exhibitions, festivals, and cultural events to celebrate and promote Tamil arts, music, dance, and heritage worldwide.
home.mission.museum.title: Museum & Archives
home.mission.museum.desc: Curating world-class museum collections and maintaining comprehensive archives of Tamil cultural artifacts and historical documents.
home.mission.research.title: Research & Innovation
home.mission.research.desc: Advancing scholarly research in Tamil studies, archaeology, and heritage conservation using innovative technologies and methodologies.
home.mission.overview: Five interconnected pillars guide our preservation, education, celebration, museum practice, and research so Tamil heritage stays living and accessible.
home.team.directors.title: Our Directors & Heritage Specialists
home.team.directors.subtitle: Meet the dedicated experts preserving and promoting Tamil cultural heritage
home.team.museum.title: Ancient Tamil Dynasties
home.team.museum.subtitle: The great kingdoms that shaped Tamil civilization and heritage
home.process.title: Our Heritage Process
home.process.subtitle: From Discovery to Digital Preservation
home.process.description: We employ cutting-edge technology combined with traditional expertise to document, preserve, and share Tamil heritage. Our process includes field research, expert authentication, digital archiving using 3D scanning and high-resolution photography, and making resources accessible to scholars and enthusiasts worldwide.
home.library.title: Digital Library & Archives
home.library.subtitle: Access Millennia of Knowledge
home.library.description: Our digital library houses over 10,000 digitized manuscripts, rare palm leaf texts, ancient inscriptions, and historical documents. Explore Tamil literature from the Sangam period, medieval devotional poetry, scientific treatises, and more. All materials are catalogued, searchable, and available for research.
home.palaces.title: Magnificent Tamil Temples & Palaces
home.palaces.subtitle: Architectural Marvels of the Chola, Pandya, and Pallava Dynasties
home.registration.title: Our Registration Block
home.registration.subtitle: Join Our Heritage Preservation Initiative
home.registration.description: Become part of our mission to preserve Tamil cultural heritage. Register for workshops, seminars, and collaborative research projects. Connect with scholars, artists, and heritage enthusiasts.
home.exhibitions.title: Setup and Exhibitions
home.exhibitions.subtitle: Curated Collections & Traveling Exhibitions
home.exhibitions.description: Experience Tamil heritage through our carefully curated exhibitions featuring ancient artifacts, temple sculptures, traditional textiles, and musical instruments. Our traveling exhibitions bring Tamil culture to museums and universities worldwide.
home.chronicles.title: Heritage Chronicles
home.chronicles.subtitle: Stories from Ancient Tamil Lands
home.museum.title: Visit our Museum
home.museum.subtitle: Experience History Come Alive
home.museum.description: Step into our world-class museum featuring rare artifacts, temple treasures, ancient sculptures, and interactive exhibits. Guided tours available in Tamil, English, and other languages. Open Tuesday-Sunday, 10 AM - 6 PM.
home.research.title: Research & Innovation
home.research.subtitle: Advancing Heritage Science
home.research.description: Our research wing collaborates with leading universities and institutions worldwide to apply innovative technologies in heritage preservation, including AI-powered manuscript restoration, 3D reconstruction of ancient sites, and climate-controlled preservation techniques.
home.collaborations.title: Our Collaborations
home.collaborations.subtitle: Partnering with institutions worldwide to preserve and promote Tamil heritage
home.collaborations.partnerFocus.heritag: Working with UNESCO experts to safeguard intangible heritage listings and temple conservation blueprints.
home.collaborations.partnerFocus.researc: Joint archival projects digitizing palm-leaf manuscripts and Sangam literature collections.
home.collaborations.partnerFocus.conserv: Field labs restoring sculpture, mural pigments, and ritual artifacts using climate-smart methods.
home.collaborations.partnerFocus.program: Community-led festivals, language workshops, and diaspora youth engagement programs.
home.collaborations.partnerFocus.digital: Open-access digital repositories and immersive 3D heritage storytelling platforms.
home.collaborations.partnerFocus.communi: Preserving oral traditions and folk songs with knowledge keepers across the Indian Ocean.
home.recognition.title: Global Recognition & Heritage Impact
home.recognition.subtitle: Our research and preservation efforts resonate worldwide
home.recognition.description: International cultural councils and diaspora organizations acknowledge Meenkodi’s evidence-driven preservation model, ensuring Tamil heritage narratives remain accessible, inclusive, and future-ready.
home.recognition.cards.unesco.title: UNESCO Living Heritage Honours
home.recognition.cards.unesco.descriptio: Recognized for documenting endangered temple rituals and classical artforms under the 2024 Living Heritage initiative.
home.recognition.cards.icomos.title: World Heritage Research Fellowship
home.recognition.cards.icomos.descriptio: Awarded annual fellowships for conservation studies on Chola architecture and maritime trade routes.
home.recognition.cards.diaspora.title: Diaspora Cultural Impact Awards
home.recognition.cards.diaspora.descript: Celebrated for bridging transnational Tamil communities through digital exhibitions and youth residencies.
home.initiatives.title: Signature Heritage Initiatives
home.initiatives.subtitle: Experiences that reconnect communities with Tamil civilization
home.initiatives.library.title: Digital Palm Leaf Library
home.initiatives.library.description: Browse authenticated manuscripts, inscriptions, and curated learning paths designed for researchers and students alike.
home.initiatives.museum.title: Immersive Heritage Museum
home.initiatives.museum.description: Explore 3D temple walkthroughs, curated exhibits, and conservation in action at our Chennai museum campus.
home.initiatives.education.title: Tamil Knowledge Studios
home.initiatives.education.description: Join masterclasses, language labs, and fellowship studios linking scholars with community storytellers.
home.initiatives.field.title: Living Heritage Residencies
home.initiatives.field.description: Spend immersive weeks in temple towns and craft clusters, documenting rituals with our mentors and co-creating conservation toolkits with local communities.
home.community.title: Community
home.community.heading: Join the Global Tamil Heritage Movement
home.community.description: Volunteer, donate, or collaborate with us to keep living traditions vibrant for future generations across Tamil Nadu and the diaspora.
home.community.engage.volunteer.title: Volunteer Heritage Fellows
home.community.engage.volunteer.descript: Lead on-ground documentation drives, oral history recordings, and youth heritage walks in your city.
home.community.engage.donate.title: Support Conservation
home.community.engage.donate.description: Help fund manuscript restoration labs, climate-controlled storage, and scholar residencies.
home.contact.title: Get in Touch
home.contact.subtitle: We'd love to hear from you! Whether you have a question, a collaboration proposal, or just want to say hello, our team is ready to assist.
home.contact.infoDescription: Visit any of our collaboration centres or reach us through the direct channels below. We actively support museums, archives, researchers, and community trusts across India.
home.contact.officesSubtitle: Walk into any of our registered, head, or capital offices for archival consultations, course enrolments, or museum partnerships.
home.contact.directSubtitle: Prefer a quick response? Reach our coordination desk through phone or email and we will respond within two working days.
home.contact.formSubtitle: Tell us about your preservation project, exhibition plan, academic research, or cultural partnership request. Our heritage desk will get in touch with tailored next steps.
home.contact.formConsent: By submitting, you consent to receive updates from the Meenkodi Heritage team about programs and collaborations.
home.contact.mapSubtitle: Located at Shinde Complex, Bavdhan Kh., Pune – our primary centre for museum projects, archival digitisation, and course coordination.
home.contact.hoursHighlight: Weekdays 9 AM – 5 PM · Saturdays till 3 PM
home.footer.description: Dedicated to preserving, documenting, and celebrating the rich cultural heritage of Tamil civilization for future generations.
